text.text_excerpt: Attended The Special Event last night as part of the event staff. This venue is huge and great for all sorts of events! From wedding receptions, to conference after parties, to holiday parties! I absolutely loved this venue last night, especially how all the bits and pieces came together. The Generations Hall staff was superb and so kind. They were always checking on the staff for the event and cleaning at all times. The bartenders were sort of slow however, but I understood considering there were about 1000 guests in attendance. Parking was not a hassle whatsoever. The security for the night was great!

I was invited to a liquor tasting in early December at Generations Hall. (Yes, a free liquor tasting and yes, I have the best friends EVER.) The space in divided in an interesting manner...I guess so you can rent just part of it. But we were in almost the whole hall. I liked that there were elevated spaces (the balcony above the stage area) and the bar in the big room that was a few steps up. The food was all catered by Miss Linda so that was yummy (if not super veggie friendly) and, of course, there was the free flowing liquor. The venue staff was quick to clean up spills and seemed on top of things. All in all a really good adaptable space for a variety of rental needs.

This place is nice on the inside, pretty big and can be a concert venue one night, a club the next, or a dinner or fancy occasion the next. Came here because it was apart of the bacchus bash block party and it was better in here than the concert outside. The place was basically split into two clubs with bars all over the place. The DJ was spinning real good music and the drinks was also pretty good and in line with standard club prices. I would come here again especially during Mardi Gras and the bacchus bash/block party.
